problems.finding: All four method-aware public resources are absent from the Frontend adapter and browser client.
problems.impact: The authorized successor path for server-derived execution class, inputs, video routing and explicit audio requirements is unreachable from the UI.
problems.action: Add typed adapter contracts and a server-derived method-aware planning surface before enabling new production writes.

problems.finding: Legacy `assets` and `media` mutation affordances remain in the generic production workspace while new G4/G5 writes are frozen.
problems.impact: A user can be invited into an operation that is guaranteed to fail for successor runs, obscuring the legal write path.
problems.action: Move legacy operations to a clearly labeled read/replay compatibility view; make method-aware actions the only primary write path.

problems.finding: Machine state, job/run refs and local-evidence labels dominate the primary screen while method-aware routing is absent.
problems.impact: Evidence can be misread as production authority or completion, especially near readiness, approval and delivery decisions.
problems.action: Use user-facing state labels plus a persistent AuthorityStatus/CapabilityBlocker; move raw refs and evidence to an inspectable details panel.

problems.finding: Series Planning has Core and adapter coverage but its project navigation item is disabled and no page exists.
problems.impact: The authored project flow breaks between project creation and world/character work.
problems.action: Implement the Series Planning workspace before widening the production funnel.

problems.finding: Bible and Character pages exist but authority status is not organized as a consistent product-level contract.
problems.impact: Users cannot clearly distinguish editable local drafts, accepted baselines and unavailable authoritative actions.
problems.action: Standardize AuthorityStatus, source lineage and blocked-action explanations.

problems.finding: No dedicated shot-graph/storyboard workspace exists for M7/M8.
problems.impact: The transition from confirmed script scenes to inspectable shots is not user-reachable.
problems.action: Add a shot navigator, storyboard canvas and read-only server plan inspection.

problems.finding: No screen explains the server-derived image/video/audio axes or source requirements.
problems.impact: Users cannot resolve missing inputs without guessing at backend policy.
problems.action: Add per-shot requirements with reason, source binding and non-overridable execution class.

problems.finding: Candidate reads and some admissions exist, but method-aware input planning, dynamic preflight and revision are not fully adapted.
problems.impact: Image iteration is fragmented and the safe preflight-to-selection path is incomplete.
problems.action: Create one candidate/revision/admission loop with explicit preflight and stale/conflict recovery.

problems.finding: The UI cannot request or display `method-aware-video-route` and cannot explain Contact/Gait unavailability in the planning context.
problems.impact: Users see a generic media pipeline instead of the server’s closed routing decision.
problems.action: Expose server-derived route results read-only and render Contact/Gait as unavailable with exact reasons; never add fallback.

problems.finding: There is no Audio Studio and `explicit-audio-requirement-route` is absent from the adapter.
problems.impact: Explicit M9 audio requirements have no product surface; Runtime G0 blockers cannot be explained in context.
problems.action: Ship a read-only/blocked Audio Studio before any runtime execution is authorized.

problems.finding: Timeline, versions, edits, deterministic effects and RenderCandidate resources are not adapted and no Timeline Studio route exists.
problems.impact: Users cannot assemble video, audio, captions and effects or create a reviewable candidate.
problems.action: Add a dedicated Timeline Studio with tracks, inspector and candidate lifecycle, gated by M13 authority.

problems.finding: The project Overview entry is visible but disabled.
problems.impact: There is no single place for readiness, blockers, recent work and the next safe action.
problems.action: Make Overview the project landing surface and surface blockers without raw backend jargon.

problems.finding: Assets, Create and Works are visible but disabled, while no Tasks destination exists.
problems.impact: The intended product loop—create, monitor, reuse, edit, deliver—has no complete global path.
problems.action: Adopt a dual-mode global IA with Home, Projects, Quick Create, Assets, Tasks and Works.

problems.finding: The wide horizontal header consumes substantial vertical space and carries too many simultaneous labels/status elements.
problems.impact: Editor canvases lose working area, especially at 1440 px and below.
problems.action: Use a compact global rail/header and a contextual project bar.

problems.finding: Global, project, planning and local workspace navigation can stack to three or four levels.
problems.impact: Orientation cost rises and content begins below multiple navigation bands.
problems.action: Collapse to one global rail plus one project navigator; keep local tabs inside the workspace.

problems.finding: Uppercase machine states, refs and evidence modes are visually louder than user goals.
problems.impact: Scanning is slow and operational implementation details leak into everyday work.
problems.action: Translate primary labels; retain exact technical evidence behind a disclosure.

problems.finding: The right inspector is long, dense and simultaneously presents state, controls, next action, readiness and truth boundaries.
problems.impact: Priority is unclear and critical blockers compete with secondary evidence.
problems.action: Separate Action, Inspector and Evidence modes with one pinned blocker summary.

problems.finding: Navigator, editor, compare surface and inspector fit, but the composition is dense around 1440–1500 px.
problems.impact: Long-form editing and comparison compete for horizontal attention.
problems.action: Persist one primary canvas and make compare/inspector mutually collapsible at medium widths.

problems.finding: Drawers make Script Studio reachable, but navigation and inspector are isolated full-screen context switches.
problems.impact: Users can lose location and comparison context during repeated mobile inspection.
problems.action: Add persistent context title, state summary and return target; keep creation scoped to lightweight actions.

problems.finding: Landing, creator forms, authored workspaces and the K2 control plane use noticeably different densities and interaction grammars.
problems.impact: The product feels assembled from separate vertical slices rather than one creation system.
problems.action: Extract shared production objects and state patterns into Design System V3 while preserving current tokens.
